name: SimilarLabs

sources.title: Submit Your Product — three submission routes (X-post free, backlink badge, $9.99 paid) with full terms

conditions: Free route 1 ('Verify with an X post'): publish a short public X/Twitter post introducing the product; manual review, no dofollow backlink
Free route 2 ('Backlink Submission'): place the SimilarLabs badge/backlink on the product homepage and keep it there; manual review, 1 dofollow link after approval
Both free routes are reviewed manually (site says usually within 7 days); only the $9.99 paid route skips verification
requirements: Submission starts from a single product homepage URL — they prefill listing details from it
Every route produces the same product page: logo, description, screenshots, categories, pricing, website link
Badge must remain on the homepage for the backlink route
Rejected paid submissions are refunded per their FAQ
preparation: Logo, description, screenshots, pricing model text for the listing
X/Twitter account able to post a public intro (for the X-post free route), OR ability to add a badge to the homepage (backlink route)
workflow: Open https://similarlabs.com/submit and paste the product URL
Choose a route: free X-post verification, free backlink-badge submission, or $9.99 paid instant
Complete the chosen verification (post on X / add badge / pay)
Manual review for free routes (usually ≤7 days); paid goes live immediately
Optionally upgrade a pending free submission to paid later
watchFor: Free X-post route yields NO dofollow backlink; only the badge route (1 link) and paid route (6+ links) do
Promotion slots (10 fixed side-rail positions) are a separate purchase — not included in any submission tier
Sign In / Launch account flow exists; expect account creation before or during submission
Hall of Fame placement is earned by votes, not automatic with submission
countsAsLive: The product has its own similarlabs.com product page and appears in the homepage 'New Launches' feed or the daily/weekly/monthly Launches lists
unknowns: Whether the X-post verification checks post content or just existence
Whether free-tier listings can be edited after publication
